narr: Although low pressure and a cold front were moving east of the region, they were still close enough to cause heavy rain and flash flooding.
ev: Multiple roads were flooded and impassable in Buena Vista Township due to flash flooding. This included Union Road and Chestnut Avenue. Some vehicles were stuck in the flood waters.
